name: room-card
title: Room card
description: A hotel room or rental: photos, size and beds, amenities, the price per night and the stay total, with 'Only 2 left' and sold-out states in words.
docs: name, beds ('1 king bed'), size ('28 m²') and sleeps describe the room; images are { src, alt } and show in a slider with arrows (on hover and focus, always on touch), native swipe and a loop. amenities lists the first maxAmenities (4) with a check mark; the 'See all 9 amenities' link appears when amenitiesHref (a real link) or onSeeAllAmenities (a callback) gives it somewhere to go, and without either every amenity is listed. pricePerNight and totalPrice are in minor units; nights writes 'for 2 nights' beside the total, and taxesIncluded (default true) chooses between 'taxes included' and 'plus taxes'. refundable says 'Free cancellation' or 'Non-refundable', and roomsLeft shows 'Only 2 left' at lowStockAt (3) or fewer; 0 turns the price into 'Not available for these dates' and disables the button, which points at that reason. onSelect is called by the button. The pictures sit on top in a narrow column and beside the details from 48rem. locale writes the prices, headingAs sets the heading level and labels holds every fixed word.
